crime: {WITCH_NAME} regularly chose a girl's next library book by remembering what the girl had finished and returned. The girl enjoyed her unexpected selections. Each evening, they met in the lounge to exchange the chosen book for one the girl had selected for {WITCH_NAME}. The girl received books she liked, while {WITCH_NAME} received a predictable private meeting without having to explain her own taste.

One afternoon in the library, {WITCH_NAME} heard the girl ask a friend to choose her next book. Before the girl had finished describing what she wanted, the friend had already taken the right volume from the shelf. The friend shared the girl's taste and agreed to join their next exchange.

That evening, the friend came to the lounge with them. {WITCH_NAME} asked how the girl chose books for her. The girl said she could only guess, because {WITCH_NAME} never said what she liked and only complained about what was wrong. {WITCH_NAME} pointed out a bent corner in the returned book, took one of the lounge swords, and advanced on the girl.

The girl seized the lounge crossbow and fired. {WITCH_NAME} stopped the bolt before it reached her, and it fell between them. The friend saw it stop and ran into the corridor to call for help. The girl turned toward the doorway. The friend did not see what happened next.

The friend looked back, passed the departing witch in the doorway, and found the girl dead beside the exchange table. The discharged crossbow lay beside the body. The stopped bolt remained between the body and where she had stood, and a deep stab wound marked the girl's upper back.

{WITCH_NAME} claimed that the girl had fired first and that the killing was self-defense. But the friend had seen her take the sword and advance before the girl raised the crossbow. The wound in the girl's back showed that after the bolt fell, the girl had turned to flee. {WITCH_NAME} had stopped the shot, pursued the retreating girl, and stabbed her from behind.
fields.epitaph: Every approach stopped short of her, until the wall crossed the distance.
execution: A massive iron wall faces her as she is restrained upright against the execution stand. It advances steadily. She tries to stop it, but the wall is not flying and continues forward. It presses her legs, pelvis, chest, arms, and skull against the stand until her entire body is crushed and she dies.

magic.name: Stillness Field
magic.text: She can stop anything flying toward her before it reaches her.
